notes: The classic shape this reviewer's brief leads with, which contract-guardian-consumer-ignores-pattern-types is not: a required property of a published schema is renamed (hex -> rgb), the TypeScript type and the Curator producer are updated in the same diff, and hue-conductor/src/server.ts is touched for an unrelated reason (a log line) while still calling colors.map(c => c.hex). Every piece of evidence is inside the diff, because contract-guardian is given the schemas as context but never consumer source — so a case whose stale consumer sits outside the diff would be unfindable by construction. Hand-authored: no commit in this repo renames a contract field. Written to look like a real rename PR that missed one call site, not like vandalism.
